cwe.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine

real_world_analog.summary: Server-side template injection in Strapi: email templates rendered with a template engine executed attacker input (CWE-1336).
real_world_analog.fix: Render untrusted subjects in a sandboxed environment instead of the default one; this case uses an equivalent containment (SandboxedEnvironment).
real_world_analog.verification: CVE number and summary confirmed via web search on 2026-11-01; the app in this case is original synthetic code.

note: Self-contained oracle case. Proven directly with effect='canary_exec'. No upstream repo/commit applies because the code is original synthetic code written for this case.
